distribution: Demo-only game assets, not npm library assets. Upstream rights apply separately from this project MIT license.
selectionBasis: Select official v1.26.60.5 full merged-release PNGs. Every selected byte sequence is also present in an installed vanilla or version-overlay candidate. No runtime pack activation or precedence is inferred from folder names, manifests or file presence.

audit.scope: All installed resource_packs/vanilla* directories, exact requested paths in loose files and __brarchive/textures/items.brarchive or ui.brarchive. Candidate order is lexical directory order, not runtime precedence.
audit.caveat: In particular vanilla_1.21.90 advertises capability pbr. This audit does not prove whether PBR or any version overlay is active in a running session. Platform packs, user packs and native renderer changes may alter actual runtime output.

historicalSwordCorrection.earlierClaimWithdrawn: The earlier conclusion that the installed game sword differs from public samples by22 pixels treated only the vanilla base entry as current runtime authority and overlooked version overlays.
historicalSwordCorrection.correctInterpretation: The22-pixel delta is base-entry versus official merged-release PNG. Installed version overlays include matching merged bytes; this is not evidence of a current-runtime-versus-sample discrepancy.

rendering.missingMaterialBehavior: Keep item name, quantity, tooltip and semantic occupancy; draw no replacement letter/icon. data-missing-material identifies this condition.

inventoryAudit.limitation: Original asset hashes prove texture fidelity, not complete native inventory custom renderer fidelity.
